verification: Rates were read from the published OpenAI developer pricing page on 2026-11-07 (standard tier, short-context). The page shows no version number. The owner must re-check them against the live page before the first charged run; the runner refuses live execution once retrieved_utc is older than max_age_days or when the model is not listed here.

gpt-6.1-sol.verification_source: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-6.1-sol and the pricing page standard table row (short context, up to 272K input tokens; longer prompts are priced higher and are refused by the runner). Responses API, function calling and reasoning.effort low|medium|high|xhigh|max are listed.
gpt-6.1-sol.image_note: The vision guide does NOT state an image rule for gpt-6.1-sol. Conservative bound, not a published rule: the highest published multiplier (2.46) over the API's 30,000-patch rejection limit.

gpt-6-luna.verification_source: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-6-luna and the pricing page standard table row (short context). Responses API, function calling and reasoning.effort none|low|medium|high|xhigh|max are listed for the model.
gpt-6-luna.image_note: The vision guide does NOT state an image rule for gpt-6-luna. This is a deliberately conservative bound, not a published rule: the highest published multiplier (2.46) over the API's 30,000-patch rejection limit. Real cost for small images is far lower; the bound only keeps reservations safe.
